### Checklist
- [ ] Adds exactly one folder under `THM/` named `thm_<name>`
- [ ] Includes `conf_theme.cfg` (or I'm intentionally using the default layout)
- [ ] Includes `preview.png` (screenshot of the theme in use)
- [ ] Tested on real PS2 hardware **or** PCSX2 (stated above)
- [ ] `python3 tools/build_inventory.py --check` passes locally
- [ ] I made this theme or have permission to redistribute every asset in it
